reason: Both correctly identified overheat protection from the new drawer unit as the most likely cause and avoided unjustified part recommendations, but Conversation 1 repeatedly asked the homeowner to check under the hob after they had explicitly refused, and ended with an unsupported leap that 'the fan itself has likely failed' if clearances are fine. Conversation 2 respected the refusal, offered sensible no-DIY workarounds (film the display to catch the code, reduce boost use, empty the drawer), and gave the right escalation: call the fitter back to correct ventilation clearance per Samsung's installation guide, with Samsung support/engineer as the fallback. Conversation 2's opening was overlong with a scattershot list, but its handling of the constraint and its honest, well-hedged escalation path served the homeowner better.
